Foodies Link Up 🇯🇲🍛 Still in Miami? Carnival runs through Thursday, and you shouldn't leave without a real plate.

Mangrove in Downtown Miami is Chef Wayne Sharpe's Kingston-inspired kitchen and lounge — he co-founded it alongside sister spot Jrk!, and the spice stays at full strength. Order the curry oxtail or the ginger rosemary snapper, then stay when the kitchen closes and the dance floor opens.

Reservations → link in bio · @mangrove.miami
